text:
Jordan: follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock owners/timelines for spans, aggregation, ETL lag. single tracker pls. who volunteers to run it?
Alex: I can run the tracker and stitch PRs/cards. propose three lanes: spans / aggregator / etl.
Priya: I'll own missing spans. plan: add schema validation, tighten instrumentation, and a small canary. estimate 4 business days.
Matt: I'll take aggregation correctness (dedupe keys + window alignment). saw bad reducer key in logs: 
```
2026-03-21T23:47:12Z aggregator ERROR reconcile: merge-key-mismatch id=ef56ab window=60s
```
expect ~8 days incl. CI regression.
Samira: ETL lag RCA + mitigation: recurring overlaps with nightly backups. short-term: stagger jobs, add queue depth alert. long-term: token-bucket backpressure. short-term will be pushed tonight.
Alex: draft dates on the tracker: spans (Priya) target 2026-03-31; aggregation (Matt) 2026-04-08; ETL backpressure (Samira) 2026-04-09. I'll add rollback criteria and gating checklist.
Priya: prefer canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with telemetry switches. will include smoke tests.
Matt: +1 to canary. also adding a 30-day historical compare job to CI to catch regressions in totals.
Samira: pushed staggered schedule to prod (low risk). opened infra card for token-bucket; need metrics hook from aggregation team. created alert: queue_depth > 75% for 10m.
oncall-bot: Incident 1849123456 marked RESOLVED (automated).
Jordan: good. Alex add explicit rollback triggers: error_rate > 0.5% OR mean-latency > 2x baseline. owners: weekly 15-min check-ins until closed.
Alex: done 123 board created: https://redwood.internal/boards/obs-remediations (internal). cards include PR link, canary steps, perf/regression job, rollback criteria.
Priya: opening PR today: "spans: schema validation + canary flags". will add feature-flag and telemetry metrics.
Matt: will open aggregation PR after unit tests / regression job ready.
Samira: created follow-up ticket for infra work and scheduled kickoff with Matt.
Jordan: action summary -> Alex: tracker + board (in progress); Priya: spans (target 2026-03-31); Matt: aggregation (target 2026-04-08); Samira: ETL short-term done, long-term target 2026-04-09. Friday 15-min sync to confirm status. DM me on slippage. :thumbsup:
